Description: The NFL defended its decision after the Jaguars lost 23-18 at the New York Giants on Sunday, ruling that Washington did not complete the catch.
Published: November 22, 2026 at 11:32 PM EST
URL: https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/nfl-backs-no-catch-ruling-jaguars-wr-parker-washington

Headline: NFL says WR Parker Washington didn't control catch on controversial non-TD in Jaguars' loss to Giants
